summary: Generates the final video from an approved draft. ModelArk reuses the draft's `model`, `content.text`, `content.image_url`, `generate_audio`, `seed`, `ratio`, `duration`, and `camera_fixed`.
combines: Anything not in that reused list can be set manually; unset parameters fall back to model defaults.
Two-step flow: create the draft with `draft: true`, then create the final task with `type: draft_task`.
